meta.name: gaai-oss-bootstrap
meta.description: Initialize or refresh a project's GAAI OSS memory by activating the Bootstrap Agent and context-bootstrap workflow.

copy.tagline: 初始化或刷新项目记忆，激活引导智能体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中初始化或刷新GAAI OSS记忆
copy.tagline_en: Initialize or refresh project memory by activating bootstrap agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to initialize or refresh GAAI OSS memory in a project

howto.what: 装上后，当你要初始化或刷新项目的GAAI OSS记忆时，Claude会读取核心配置文件，按步骤执行引导工作流，最后报告通过/失败并指出差距。完成后会提示记忆已就绪，并建议使用`$gaai-oss:discover`来定义治理工作。
howto.when: 当你想初始化代码库的GAAI、刷新过时的记忆、重建项目上下文，或确认内存文件夹是否反映最新仓库时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化这个项目的GAAI OSS记忆。
刷新项目上下文，检查内存是否最新。
say.note: Claude会验证并更新内存状态。
Claude将按步骤操作并给出PASS/FAIL报告。

howto.what_en: When you ask to initialize or refresh a project's GAAI OSS memory, Claude reads core config files, executes the bootstrap workflow step by step, and reports PASS/FAIL with remaining gaps. Upon completion, it tells you memory is ready and suggests using `$gaai-oss:discover` for governed work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to initialize GAAI on a codebase, refresh stale memory, rebuild project context, or verify that `.gaai/project/contexts/memory/` reflects the current repository.

say_en.text: Initialize the GAAI OSS memory for this project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the bootstrap process, reads configs, and prepares memory.

say_en.text: Refresh project context and check if memory is up-to-date.
say_en.note: Claude verifies and updates the memory state.

say_en.text: Run bootstrap and report the outcome.
say_en.note: Claude follows the workflow and gives a PASS/FAIL report.
